text:
maria: Heads up — product asked for on‑prem/VPC metrics exports to our telemetry service. Need infra + security alignment on agent egress, KMS hooks, and audit log payloads.

jon: Do we intend a push agent from customer networks or a pull-based collector inside their VPC?

maria: Push agent (customer-hosted) that forwards encrypted batches to our collector endpoints. Pull would require peering and is heavier for private customers.

ashok: Ok. Push means customers need outbound rules only. We should be very explicit about allowed ports/hosts.

paula: Security note — all exports must be TLS 1.2+ with server cert verification and client mTLS optional but strongly recommended for enterprise. KMS wrapping for persisted files required for on‑disk cache.

kevin: For firewall docs, customers typically allow TLS 443. Are we standardizing on 443 or do we need additional ports?

maria: Goal: single egress host (telemetry.redwood.ai) on 443. For some on‑prem collectors we also support mTLS on 15001 when customers want private endpoints.

jon: Can we get a stable IP range for allowlisting? Customers keep asking.

ashok: We can provide a small ASN-backed CIDR set but we prefer DNS-based allowlisting. We will publish an IP prefix list updated daily and a signed manifest for automation.

paula: Audit requirement — every exported batch must include request_id, model_id, deployment, and a provenance_signature that we generate via KMS signing. Is that feasible?

maria: Yes. Plan: agent will attach a per-batch header: X-RW-Provenance: <base64(sig)>. The signature is over JSON: {request_ids[], model_version, ts, batch_size}. Signature created with our signing KMS key (customer-private wrapper).

security: We need to validate that signature flow doesn't expose KMS credentials. Proposal: customer agent requests a short-lived asymmetric cert from our control plane (signed by HSM key) that it uses to sign payloads locally. Control plane issues cert with CSR flow and audits issuance to customer audit logs.

kevin: That implies KMS/HSM integration + rotation. Ops: we need an endpoint to request certs (mTLS) and an audit trail stored in the customer's audit log sink.

jon: Implementation question: what metrics and labels do console/dashboard teams need? We should lock schema before agent v1.

paula: Minimum metrics: tokens_served_total, kv_cache_hit_ratio (gauge), batch_size_histogram, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, failed_exports_total. Labels: deployment, model_version, region, routing_policy, customer_id.

maria: Add telemetry tag for export_path (onprem/vpc/dedicated) so UI can filter private exports.

ashok: We should also emit internal runtime counters: local_kv_cache_bytes and active_batch_workers to diagnose memory.

jon: For dashboards we'll need an ingest mapping. Console team — can you confirm you can consume these labels?

paula: Also need to ensure PII-free payloads. Strip any prompt text from metrics and only include identifiers.

maria: Agent config example (draft):

```
agent:
  export_endpoint: "https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/exports"
  use_mtls: true
  mtls_port: 15001
  batch_max: 500
  encrypt_on_disk: true
  kms_key_uri: "aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:..."  # customer wrapper
  provenance_header: "X-RW-Provenance"
  labels: ["deployment","model_version","region","routing_policy","customer_id"]
```

kevin: That looks good. For firewall docs we'll publish both FQDN + IP prefix list + instruction to allow outbound 443/15001 to those hosts.

security: One more: export retry/backoff semantics must surface to audit logs. If an export fails after retries we need an explicit audit record with error_code and attempt_count.

maria: Agree. UX: rollout will be behind a feature flag per-customer. Start canary with 5 customers in staging networks, then 10 enterprise pilots. Need checklist for SRE oncall.

jon: Action items:
- infra (ashok/kevin): publish IP prefix list + egress docs, provide collector hostnames and cert pinning guidance.
- security (paula): finalize KMS signing/CAs flow and audit requirements.
- runtime (maria/jon): update agent to include provenance header and labels + disk encryption.
- console (paula?): map metrics schema to dashboards and confirm ingest mapping.

paula: I can take console mapping and audit spec.

ashok: I'll draft the allowlist manifest and automation hook.

kevin: I'll prepare the firewall KB and sample iptables rules for on‑prem appliances.

maria: Great. Can folks ack here and I'll create the RFC with the schema/agent spec? :thumbsup:

jon: Ack

ashok: Ack

paula: Ack

kevin: Ack

security: Ack

sre-bot: Incident policy reminder — any rollout that changes egress behavior requires a runbook update and a prelaunch blast to oncall.

maria: Noted. I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to walk through the RFC and action owners.

jon: Thanks — will join.

paula: I'll bring the audit log format spec to the sync.

maria: Thanks everyone.
